audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' (flat template) while content win[0..6] already reads Pyke/Pyke/Pyke/Pyke/Pyke/Pyke/Braum, and content whys[]/spikes[] fully justify a Pyke-dominant early-mid flipping to Braum at 2+ items. The two layers directly contradicted each other.
audit.why: A reader sees a flat 'Skill' level chart next to prose that explicitly says Pyke wins levels 1-5 and first item — the page argues with itself.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..5].side to Pyke and phases[6].side to Braum (matching win[] which was already correct, so no content edit needed), rewrote each .why to state the specific reason, and set ratings to reflect Pyke favor early/mid and a Braum-favored 2+ item stage.

audit.why: Level 2 all-in (Q+E), level 6 Death From Below execute/reset, and the 2+ item flip are all already named correctly in spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were unmentioned: Gift of the Drowned Ones (P) means Pyke gets bonus AD instead of max HP, so pure armour/MR stacking against him is a weaker answer than it looks; and Ghostwater Dive (W) stealth has no reveal on Braum's kit, so a Control Ward/sweeper is mandatory.
audit.why: Both were flagged as applicable-but-unmentioned for this exact matchup and change itemization and vision decisions.
audit.corrected: Folded into breakdown.trading (both) and dontsFull[2].d (stealth-into-trade risk).

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: His charged Bone Skewer (Q) outranges your engage — play back until it's thrown, not before.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: His Q-into-E dash-stun is a real all-in at 2 — it beats your four-stack Concussive Blows.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: Full hook-into-dash combo pressure outpaces your stack-and-shield answer at 3.

edits.before: Stack the margins — every traded auto is a quarter-stun; their math hates it.
edits.after: His roam and pick threat through 4-5 stay ahead of your zone control.

edits.before: Glacial Fissure online — the line knockup starts dives and ends theirs.
edits.after: Death From Below executes and resets — Fissure can interrupt the blink.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: Roams still edge it; angle Unbreakable at his Q to survive to your spike.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: Two-plus items flip it: Unbreakable blocks the hook, Concussive Blows stuns him off any engage.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Stand Behind Me onto whoever he hooks — the shield lands before Phantom Undertow's return stun finishes the combo.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Trading right after he lands Bone Skewer feeds Death From Below reset gold to his side — disengage instead.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. It writes your spacing rules. - E Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Bone Skewer sits on a 10s cooldown, 8s at rank 5 — his R cleans what it catches, so track the hook and it writes your spacing. Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. Death From Below drops from 100s to 70s at rank 3 — it opens or closes fights, pick one per cast.

edits.before: Good trade: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all. Bad trade: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Good trade: bait Bone Skewer, eat it on Unbreakable, and punish the whiff — he can't stack HP so raw stuns and damage still land. Bad trade: face-checking for his Ghostwater stealth with no sweeper up, or trusting armour alone to cap his damage — it doesn't.
